_comment: Parity manifest (F-05-T16; chapter 04 9.3). key = <specimen id>.<part>. selector = CSS inside that specimen's section on /components. source = a PNG under $ACCRUED_HANDOFF_DIR. crop = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the PNG's own pixels (2x), or "window". sha256 pins the source (python -m abacus_tools.parity.crop_handoff --pin). tier = A to D. deviation = a known, recorded difference: reported, not blocking. locked = blocking at tier B. The PNGs are never committed.
